title: Add Emoji Field to Tickets and Create Commit Hook
description: Add an `emoji` field to all ticket implementations (Go, TypeScript, GraphQL). Extend all existing ticket JSON files with a fitting emoji. Update all tests. Create a zero-touch configured git hook that automatically creates commit messages with ticket details for dev branches.
summary: Added `emoji` field to all ticket and contributor data structures across the entire codebase. Updated Go structs (Ticket, Contributor), GraphQL schema, TypeScript types, SQL schema, JSON marshal/unmarshal. Added emojis to all 1228 ticket.json files and all 6 contributor.json files. Extended existing tests with emoji assertions (marshal, unmarshal, round-trip). Created zero-touch prepare-commit-msg git hook that auto-generates commit messages on dev branches matching `*/🏗️dev` pattern with format: `{{DevEmoji}}{{DevAlias}}🎆️YY🌙️MM☀️DD⏰️HH⌚️MM⏱️SS🚩️` subject line, grouped ticket list body, and Signed-off-by footer.
